title: From offset to cursor pagination, API and client
prompt: The nightly orders export sometimes contains the same order twice and misses others: new orders keep arriving while it pages through GET /orders, and the offsets shift under it. Switch listOrders to cursor-based pagination — an opaque `cursor` query parameter in, `nextCursor` in the response (null on the last page), and a 400 for a cursor the API did not issue — and update the export client to use it. The limit keeps working as it does today.
check: hidden ts-cursor-pagination && rm -rf dist && tsc -p . && node --test dist/test/api.test.js dist/test/cursor.hidden.test.js
